shortBio.en: Sex Pistols bassist 1977–78; symbol more than technician—Matlock’s exit makes the swap a media event.
shortBio.zh: Sex Pistols 贝斯 1977–78；符号多于技术——Matlock 离开使替换成媒体事件。

body.en: Joins after Matlock. Limited bass skill; large tabloid silhouette. Dies 1979. Useful as a reminder that punk lore and punk records are not always the same object.
body.zh: Matlock 之后加入。贝斯技术有限；小报剪影巨大。1979 年去世。用来提醒：朋克传说与朋克唱片不总是同一对象。
